services.name: First session
services.story: The main story: Alex's $190 first session with Maya, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, after a free fit check call. A card is saved, nothing taken. The desk checks Alex's plan by hand, and what's owed goes on the saved card when Maya texts DONE: nobody is at the desk on Saturdays.

services.name: First session
services.story: The same first session when the front desk is open: Alex pays at the desk. The saved card is only for the $75 late-cancel fee, with Sam's yes.

services.name: First session
services.story: The same session for a fee-free client, whose plan bars missed-session fees: nothing is taken and no card is saved. Anything owed is paid at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: David (therapist and family therapist) and Elena (associate therapist)
B.customer: Alex M. (client, who can't easily leave home for now) · other clients

services.name: First in-home session
services.story: The main story: Alex, who can't easily leave home, pays for a $179 first in-home session with David, Thu Oct 22 at 8:00am. A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel fee, and the $179 is charged at DONE. The receipt has what Alex's plan needs to pay Alex back.

services.name: First in-home session
services.story: The same session when Alex's plan pays in network and bars late fees: nothing is taken, no card is saved, and the office bills the plan its own way.

services_shape: one client with one therapist at a time, each session a set length; a new client starts with a free fit check call, then a longer first session; ongoing sessions are weekly, with a weekly time the client says yes to; in a couples or family session, each adult confirms on their own page
questions_before_times: for you (18 or older), or for your teen (a parent or guardian books)
which state you'll be in during your sessions
a health plan (its name only), or paying yourself
what you'd like in a therapist, in your own words: like a woman or a man, a language, Saturdays or evenings, the office, video or your home
for a session at home: the town, and the kind of place
safety_stop: harming someone else, or anyone in danger right now
first_steps: The plan's OK for sessions ahead
license: always: each therapist holds their own active license from the state's board for their kind of license (like a counselor, a social worker, a marriage and family therapist or a psychologist); the state's form says which licenses may give therapy
staff_skills: who sees adults, teens, couples and families; who offers video and home sessions; who speaks which language; how each lists themselves (like a woman or a man) for clients who ask
messages_never: client texts carry only the display name, the date, the time, the place and a secure link: never 'therapy', 'counseling', the kind of session, a reason, a diagnosis, a medicine name or a child's details; at the office, never the therapist's name (it's on the secure page); at home, the therapist's name and photo stay, for the door check; the video link stays on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
